repair_accounting.root_cause: The capture received a repository-relative artifacts/... output path inside the Test Executor read-only package instead of the executor-provided writable directory.

purpose: Add one task-local adapter and its synthetic unit tests so a later separately authorized Test Executor job can route the frozen capture into BM_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR without changing the capture implementation, source identities, ordering, evidence semantics or budgets.

requirements: Import and delegate to scripts/research/sc001_x1_pit_lineage_capture_v0_1.py; do not duplicate or alter capture/source logic.
Accept no CLI arguments. Any argument fails closed with exit code 2 before delegation.
Read only the exact environment key BM_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR for the executor-owned output root.
Fail closed with exit code 2 if BM_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR is missing, empty, non-absolute, nonexistent, not a directory, or cannot be resolved.
Resolve the executor output root and append the fixed child name sc001-x1-pit-metadata-capture.
Prove the resolved fixed child remains beneath the resolved executor output root before delegation.
Delegate exactly once to capture.main with ['--output-dir', '<resolved-root>/sc001-x1-pit-metadata-capture'].
Preserve the delegated capture exit code exactly.
Do not read or change URLs, request classes, ordering, request/byte caps, timeout, source qualification, evidence semantics, collectors, credentials, trading, VPS or Runner state.
Import the task-local adapter and mock capture.main so the suite performs zero network requests and creates no market evidence.
Test missing BM_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR fails closed without delegation.
Test empty BM_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR fails closed without delegation.
Test relative BM_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR fails closed without delegation.
Test nonexistent BM_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR fails closed without delegation.
Test unexpected CLI argument fails closed without delegation.
Test a valid absolute writable temporary root delegates exactly once with the exact fixed child path.
Test the adapter preserves both delegated success and SOURCE_INCOMPLETE exit codes without changing arguments.

successor_boundary.on_design_ready: Strategy Control must statically/adversarially review the exact PR head and two-file delta. If PASS, it may canonicalize that exact head and dispatch one separately bounded offline Test Executor self-test task. The worker must not merge or execute tests.

hard_prohibitions: No Test Executor job in this task.
No network access or source capture.
No Research Runner or Runner Probe.
No market body, price, return, correlation, lag, PnL or protected outcome access.
No collector, credential or trading action.
No change to the existing capture implementation or its existing tests.
No roadmap, governance, policy, charter, contamination registry, reusable registry or frozen research-rule change.
No merge, close, draft/ready toggle or branch deletion by the worker.
